statement: GCP affinity teardown snapshots the five-node identity set before cluster.stop clears the registry, materializes every complete captured full-node log to its canonical node-N.log path before VM destruction, and preserves natural teardown plus primary-error precedence so authenticated release profiling fails only on product evidence rather than missing log artifacts.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

Cluster shutdown still precedes VM destruction, full-log streams are finalized by the existing cluster.stop owner, and materialization consumes only that finalized capture; do not retain live VMs or bypass the canonical full-node-log capture path.
Preserve the existing failure precedence: cluster-stop failure first, then log-materialization failure, then provisioner-destroy failure, while every teardown phase remains best-effort attempted.
Do not change formation, event-loop, fingerprint, natural-termination, node-count, or profile completeness predicates; the change supplies the artifacts those predicates already require.
